title: manifest
description: What `wilanis manifest` prints (RFC 0026): what a tree is, as one JSON object on stdout, computed by the runtime's pure `manifestOf` from a tree the checker accepted. It never reads the environment, the clock or a secret's value. Every array is sorted by its first key, in code units, except a trigger's policies and the startup steps, whose order is meaning; so the same tree prints the same bytes, and a diff of two manifests is a diff of what the tree does. From 1.0 a field is added, never removed or retyped, and the sort is part of the promise; before 1.0 nothing is promised.

format.description: Which envelope this is. 1 until a change a reader could not ignore, which takes the next number.

runtime.description: The version of @wilanis/runtime that printed it; the workspace pins every sibling package to it.

ir.description: The schema version the documents are written against, RFC 0008's segment of the published base: v1 while it is main or schemas-v1.

name.description: The tree's name, as project.json says it.

root.description: The tree's root as given on the command line, `.` when none was given.

includes.description: Every tree project.json includes, by package.

features.description: Every feature a document sits in, by name.

documents.description: Every document the tree loaded, plugins' and included trees' among them, by path: what `wilanis ls` lists, as data.

ports.description: Every port, split by who meets it: the tree's bindings, or a plugin's handlers.

domain.description: Every port a binding meets, by path.

native.description: Every port a plugin grants, by path.

secrets.description: The secrets project.json declares, key to the environment variable that holds it, by key: the variable's name, never its value.

startup.description: The startup steps in the order project.json declares them, which is the order they run in.

document.description: One document the tree loaded: its own, an included tree's, or one a plugin ships.

path.description: The document's canonical path: @features/..., @connections/..., @project.json, or @<plugin>/... for a plugin's.

kind.description: The kind its $schema names: project, port, trigger, and so on.

feature.description: The feature folder it sits in; null outside features/ and for a plugin's document.

layer.description: The layer directory it sits in, read off its path; null where it sits in none.

included.description: The package it was included from; null when it is this tree's own or a plugin's.

use.description: The plugin's root, as project.json's `use` names it: @http.

from.description: The npm package it was loaded from; null for a plugin the runtime ships (@std, @cli).

version.description: The version of that package as resolved from the tree's node_modules, the runtime's own for a plugin it ships; null where the plugin was handed in rather than resolved.

guard.description: Whether its plugin.json declares a guard: the one plugin that identifies callers.

from.description: The npm package the tree is included from.

version.description: The version of that package as resolved from the tree's node_modules; null where it was handed in without one.

features.description: The features of it that loaded here, by name, sorted.

feature.description: One feature: a folder under features/, this tree's or an included one's.

included.description: The package it was included from; null when it is this tree's own.

effects.description: The native operations its feature.json allows, canonical and sorted; empty where it declares none.

trigger.description: One trigger: what starts a run, and what gates it.

kind.description: The canonical path of the trigger kind it is, which declares the shape of its settings.

settings.description: Its settings as the document wrote them: an http trigger's route and method, a queue's or a schedule's own. Their shape is the kind's schema's, not restated here.

fires.description: The domain port operation it fires, canonical, as path#operation.

policies.description: The canonical paths of the policies it attaches, in the order it attaches them, which is the order they run in.

public.description: Whether it attaches no policy, so that anyone who reaches it runs it.

included.description: The package it was included from; null when it is this tree's own.

domainOperation.description: One operation of a domain port.

name.description: The operation's name in its port.

firedBy.description: The triggers whose fire names it, by canonical path, sorted; empty when only a policy, a graph or a startup step reaches it.

public.description: Whether any trigger that fires it is public.

domainPort.description: One port the tree binds: a feature's domain port, or one a plugin requires and the host binds.

feature.description: The feature it sits in; null for a port a plugin requires.

bindings.description: Every binding of it, by canonical path, sorted: the inventory is the same under every profile, so this is every binding one might choose.

nativeOperation.description: One operation of a native port, and what its port document promises of it.

name.description: The operation's name in its port.

pure.description: Whether it is marked pure: no effect, the same answer for the same inputs.

holds.description: Whether it is marked holds: it starts something that outlives its run, which only a startup step may name.

path.description: The port's canonical path, under the plugin's root.

grantedBy.description: The plugin that grants it, by its `use`.

policy.description: One policy: a gate a trigger attaches.

decides.description: The domain port operation its decide fires, canonical, as path#operation.

proves.description: The request.* paths present once it allows, sorted; empty where it proves none.

gates.description: The triggers that attach it, by canonical path, sorted.

included.description: The package it was included from; null when it is this tree's own.

kind.description: The canonical path of the connection kind it is.

settings.description: Its settings as the document wrote them: a template reading a secret stays {{secrets.<key>}} text, and a secret's value never appears.

secrets.description: The secret keys its settings read, sorted; empty where they read none.

label.description: The step's label; null where it has none.

run.description: The operation it runs, canonical, as path#operation.

required.description: Whether starting stops when the step refuses; true where the document leaves it out, as it runs.

profiles.description: The profiles it runs under, sorted; null where it names none and so runs under every one.
